description: Takes the XML of an e-invoice in UBL or UN/CEFACT CII syntax (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD or Factur-X) and reads number, dates, seller, buyer, VAT IDs, purchase order reference, lines, totals, tax per rate and payment details. Checks the mandatory details (red if missing, yellow for purchase order reference, delivery date and IBAN), whether net plus tax equals gross, whether the lines add up to the net total, tax per rate and the amount due, and flags profiles that are not valid as an e-invoice (MINIMUM, BASIC WL). Checks mandatory details and arithmetic, not a full validation against the schema and rules of the standard. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

xml.description: The XML of the e-invoice (UBL or CII). For ZUGFeRD PDFs the embedded XML file.

name: check_einvoice
title: E-invoice checker: reads an XRechnung or ZUGFeRD XML (UBL or CII) and checks mandatory details and arithmetic
